units.source_text: 夜色渐深，管弦之声更增佳趣。

en.t: As the night deepened, the sound of the music grew even more delightful.

units.source_text: 薰大将唱催马乐《安名尊》的嗓音美妙极了。

en.t: Kaoru, the General, sang the saibara song Anason in an exceptionally beautiful voice.

units.source_text: 按察大纳言昔年擅长唱歌，至今不曾荒疏，此时也神气十足地起来和薰大将合唱。

en.t: The Inspector Grand Counselor had been skilled at singing in former years and had not lost his ability, so now he rose in high spirits and sang together with Kaoru, the General.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣的第七位公子，还是个幼童，已能吹笙，吹得非常美妙。

en.t: The seventh son of Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, was still only a child, yet he could already play the sho, and he played it very beautifully.
The reigning Emperor bestowed a set of court robes on him.

units.source_text: 他的父亲便下阶拜舞谢恩。

en.t: His father then descended the steps and performed a dance of obeisance in thanks.

units.source_text: 今上于天色近晓之时还宫。

en.t: The reigning Emperor returned to the palace when dawn was drawing near.

units.source_text: 犒赏物品，公卿及亲王等由今上颁赐；

en.t: As for the rewards, the Emperor bestowed gifts on the high courtiers, imperial princes, and others;

units.source_text: 殿上人及乐人则由二公主赏赐，品类甚多。

en.t: while the palace courtiers and musicians received many kinds of gifts from the Second Princess.
